Single-Point vs Multipoint Error Budget
What this shows: Side-by-side comparison of the IFT-predicted errors (|Δxpredicted|) from the single-point and multipoint polynomial systems.
Single-point (max order 4, t = 1.667): uses one time point, requires higher-order derivatives.
Multipoint (max order 3, t = 6.233, 18.750): uses 2 time points with shared parameters, reducing the max derivative order needed. Lower order = more accurate interpolation = smaller data errors.
Improvement = |SP predicted| / |MP predicted|. Values >1 mean multipoint predicts smaller errors for that parameter.
